name: Voxflow
_comment: Voxflow carries its own features on top of Handy, so most of its changes are ordinary code, merged by hand. These edits are the identity that must never revert to Handy's in a merge; apply.py --check catches it if one does. See docs/UPSTREAM.md.

lines: This repository is **Voxflow**, a fork of [Handy](https://github.com/cjpais/Handy) with its own features on top. Read `docs/UPSTREAM.md` first. In short:
- Voxflow's name, bundle id, updater endpoint and signing key are guarded by `rebrand/brand.json`: after merging upstream, run `python3 rebrand/apply.py` and `--check`.
- Shared Handy packages keep their names: `handy-keys`, `handy-recorder`, `@handy-computer/models`, the blob.handy.computer model URLs.
- Never push `upstream/*` tags, and never post to cjpais/Handy.
# Voxflow (rebrand/apply.py): files we replace whole keep our version in a merge.
# Needs `git config merge.ours.driver true` once per clone (docs/UPSTREAM.md).
